## 2. Storage

### 3. Object storage

Object storage keeps files as objects in buckets. It is durable and many servers can read the same object.

Use it for images, backups and static websites.

### 4. Encryption at rest

Encryption at rest protects data on disks and snapshots if the media is stolen.
